name: Check an exact-size Shopify replacement and prepare an RVI handoff

parameters.content:
### How it works

Use this manual check before offering a same-size replacement for a sold-out Shopify variant. The workflow reads the public catalog for the buyer’s country and checks the selected size, exact variant identities and current orderability. An eligible result includes both exact links, the market, currency, size and current catalog prices. Confirm fit and delivery in Shopify before using the pair.

### Setup

Open **Edit variant links and market**. Enter the permanent `.myshopify.com` address, the uppercase two-letter buyer country and the exact size option name used in Shopify, such as `Taille`. Paste HTTPS links for two different published products on the same storefront and language path, each ending in `?variant=` followed by its exact ID. Enter the Shopify language code for translated handles. The public query needs no Shopify credentials.

Run the workflow manually and open **Verify exact size and availability**. An eligible pair includes a portable RVI code. In RVI, import the eligible output JSON, paste the code, or save the four-line text as `rvi-footwear-pair.txt`. Approve fit in RVI, which checks the Shopify catalog again before saving. If eligibility is unverified, check the links, country and size option, then rerun.

[Setup guide and example](https://recently-viewed-products.fly.dev/n8n-shopify-exact-size?ref=n8n-workflow-v3)

## Set up the pair

Enter the original and replacement in one buyer country. Run the check manually after confirming both links select the intended variants.

## Read and verify Shopify evidence

Validate the inputs before requesting the catalog. A pair qualifies only when the source is sold out and the exact replacement is immediately orderable in the same size.
